experiment: Three two-purlin-line, three-span continuous, through-fastened, unbraced C-purlin roof assemblies with reduced interior-support lap lengths (20 ft, 23 ft 6 in. and 30 ft spans) were loaded to failure by uplift (vacuum) in a test chamber, and the measured failure loads were converted to failure moments and compared with computed constrained-bending capacities.
title: Uplift Capacity of Unbraced, Continuous-Span, Through-Fastened C-Purlin Supported Roof Systems with Reduced Lap Lengths

variables.definition: Designation of each three-span C-purlin uplift test assembly (C1, C2, C3).
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.10; Table 2.2 p.10; Table 3.1 p.12; Table S1
variables.name: Test designation

variables.definition: Grouping key naming the set of tests averaged in the reduction-factor statistics (Laboube et al. 1988 data, current tests, or all).
variables.name: Test set grouping

variables.definition: Purlin line of the two-purlin-line assembly (North or South) to which a measured segment belongs.
variables.evidence: Appendix A/B/C measured-dimension and section-property tables
variables.name: Purlin line
variables.note: Reconstructed (inferred) for the section-property tables by matching the appendix sketches

variables.definition: Span (bay) number of the three-span continuous system in which a purlin segment is located.
variables.evidence: Appendix A/B/C measured-dimension and section-property tables
variables.name: Bay number

variables.definition: Length of each of the three equal continuous spans of the test assembly.
variables.evidence: Table 2.1 p.10; Table 3.1 p.12; Table S1
variables.name: Span length

variables.definition: Nominal depth of the C-purlin web as specified for the test assembly.
variables.name: Nominal web depth

variables.definition: Nominal flange width of the C-purlin section.
variables.name: Nominal flange width

variables.definition: Nominal base-metal thickness of the purlins used in the assembly.
variables.name: Nominal purlin thickness

variables.definition: Lap length measured on each side of the interior support, from support centre to lap end.
variables.name: Lap length at interior support

variables.definition: Ratio of the interior-support lap length to the nominal purlin depth.
variables.name: Lap length to depth ratio

variables.definition: Measured width of the ASTM E8 tension coupon cut from an undamaged region of a failed purlin.
variables.name: Coupon width

variables.definition: Measured thickness of the tension coupon taken from the failed purlin.
variables.name: Coupon thickness

variables.definition: Yield stress of the purlin steel measured in the tension coupon test and used as the program input and in Mth.
variables.evidence: Table 2.2 p.10; Table 3.1 p.12; Appendix section-property screens; Table S1
variables.name: Yield stress

variables.definition: Tensile (ultimate) stress of the purlin steel from the coupon test.
variables.name: Tensile strength

variables.definition: Percent elongation of the steel measured in the tension coupon test.
variables.name: Elongation

variables.definition: Modulus of elasticity of the steel input to the purlin analysis program.
variables.name: Modulus of elasticity

variables.definition: Maximum uniform uplift load per purlin line at failure, computed from the maximum chamber vacuum and the 5 ft tributary width.
variables.evidence: Table 3.1 p.12; Table S1; appendix test summary sheets
variables.name: Failure uplift load per purlin line
variables.note: Net applied vacuum load, dead load not included

variables.definition: Failure moment of the purlin computed from the failure load as Mu = 0.08 wu L^2.
variables.name: Failure moment

variables.definition: Average effective section modulus of the six measured purlin cross sections of a test.
variables.name: Average effective section modulus

variables.definition: Theoretical constrained (fully braced) bending capacity computed as Mth = (Avg. Se) Fy.
variables.name: Theoretical bending capacity

variables.definition: Ratio of the test failure moment to the theoretical constrained-bending moment, equal to the AISI Section C3.1.3 reduction factor R.
variables.name: Reduction factor Mu/Mth (R)

variables.definition: Mean of the reduction factor R for each test set (previous Laboube et al. tests, current tests, all).
variables.name: Mean reduction factor

variables.definition: Dispersion of the reduction factor R printed as standard deviation for each test set.
variables.name: Std deviation of reduction factor
variables.note: Text describes these values as coefficients of variation

variables.definition: Current AISI reduction factor for continuous-span C-sections (R = 0.60) quoted for comparison with the test values.
variables.name: AISI code reduction factor
variables.note: Single stated code value, not a column

variables.definition: Base-metal thickness of the purlin measured in each bay before testing (also the thickness entered into the analysis program).
variables.evidence: Appendix A/B/C test summary sheets and section-property screens
variables.name: Measured purlin thickness per bay
variables.note: Test C3 printed values duplicate Test C2 and disagree with the C3 program output

variables.definition: Initial lateral crookedness (sweep) of each purlin segment measured before testing.
variables.evidence: Appendix A/B/C test summary sheets (pages A.1, B.1, C.1)
variables.name: Initial sweep
variables.note: Recorded as "Negligible" for all Test C1 segments

variables.definition: Measured overall depth of each purlin cross section entered into the analysis program.
variables.name: Measured purlin depth

variables.definition: Overall lip dimension of the top (compression) flange of the measured cross section.
variables.name: Top lip length

variables.definition: Overall lip dimension of the bottom (tension) flange of the measured cross section.
variables.name: Bottom lip length

variables.definition: Measured width of the top (compression) flange of each purlin segment.
variables.name: Top flange width

variables.definition: Measured width of the bottom (tension) flange of each purlin segment.
variables.name: Bottom flange width

variables.definition: Angle of the stiffening lips, listed as 90 degrees on every analysis program screen.
variables.evidence: Header note to the Appendix A/B/C section-property tables
variables.name: Lip angle
variables.note: Constant stated in a note, not a column

variables.definition: Corner radius between lip and flange input to the analysis (5/16 in. for C1 and C2, 3/8 in. for C3).
variables.evidence: Header notes to the Appendix A/B/C section-property tables
variables.name: Lip-to-flange radius
variables.note: Stated as a constant per test in a note

variables.definition: Corner radius between flange and web input to the analysis (3/8 in. for C1, 5/16 in. for C2, 3/8 in. for C3).
variables.evidence: Header notes to the Appendix A/B/C section-property tables
variables.name: Flange-to-web radius
variables.note: Stated as a constant per test in a note

variables.definition: Gross cross-sectional area of the measured purlin section computed by the analysis program.
variables.name: Gross area

variables.definition: Moment of inertia about the x-axis computed by the analysis program from the measured dimensions.
variables.name: Moment of inertia Ix
variables.note: Unit in^4; nearest available quantity kind used

variables.definition: Moment of inertia about the y-axis computed by the analysis program.
variables.name: Moment of inertia Iy
variables.note: Unit in^4; nearest available quantity kind used

variables.definition: Product of inertia of the measured cross section computed by the analysis program.
variables.name: Product of inertia Ixy
variables.note: Unit in^4; nearest available quantity kind used

variables.definition: Effective moment of inertia of the purlin section computed by the analysis program.
variables.name: Effective moment of inertia
variables.note: Unit in^4; nearest available quantity kind used

variables.definition: Effective section modulus of each measured purlin segment computed by the analysis program; averaged to give Avg. Se.
variables.name: Effective section modulus

variables.definition: Allowable positive bending moment of the measured section computed by the purlin analysis program.
variables.name: Allowable positive moment

variables.definition: Allowable negative bending moment of the measured section computed by the purlin analysis program.
variables.name: Allowable negative moment

variables.definition: Allowable shear strength of the purlin web computed by the analysis program.
variables.name: Allowable shear strength
variables.note: Printed with a blank web-stiffener spacing (Based on a = " ")

variables.definition: Allowable web crippling strength at an exterior support computed by the analysis program for N = 4 in.
variables.name: Allowable exterior web crippling

variables.definition: Allowable web crippling strength at an interior support computed by the analysis program for N = 4 in.
variables.name: Allowable interior web crippling

variables.definition: Bearing length assumed in the web crippling calculations, stated as N = 4 in. for all program screens.
variables.evidence: Header notes to the Appendix A/B/C section-property tables
variables.name: Bearing length N
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column

variables.definition: Direction of the applied load on the roof assembly (uplift, applied by evacuating air above the panels).
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Cross-section shape of the purlins tested (C-section).
variables.name: Section type

variables.definition: Number of continuous spans in the test assembly (three for all tests).
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in the test assembly (two for all tests).
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Spacing of the purlin lines, 5 ft on centre, which also defines the tributary width used to compute wu.
variables.name: Purlin spacing / tributary width
variables.note: Stated in a note, not a column

variables.definition: Type, attachment and gage of the roof panels used (through-fastened 26 or 24 gage, with two layers in C1 and C2).
variables.name: Roof panel type and gage

variables.definition: Lateral bracing condition of the purlin compression (bottom) flange; all tests were unbraced.
variables.name: Bracing condition

variables.definition: Observed mode that terminated each test (local buckling for C1 and C2; excessive lateral deflection for C3).
variables.evidence: Table S1; appendix test summary sheets pp.17, 26, 35
variables.name: Failure mode
variables.note: In the appendix measured-dimension tables it appears only as a header note
